Dr. Elena Varga  
Department of Digital Innovation  
University of TechNorth  
elena.varga@technorth.edu  

Stefan Novakovic joined my research group as a graduate student in 2019, bringing a sharp focus on product strategy within fast-paced tech environments. His work on optimizing ad-tech platforms for real-time user engagement demonstrated a clear grasp of balancing technical feasibility with business goals.  

Stefan’s strength lies in translating complex data into actionable product strategies. During his thesis work, he redesigned a client’s ad-serving architecture to prioritize user retention, which increased campaign efficacy by 18% without additional infrastructure costs. He also led a cross-functional roadmap for a mid-sized agency’s product stack, aligning engineering, design, and sales teams around a 12-month vision that reduced internal tool fragmentation by 30%. His ability to navigate stakeholder priorities while maintaining product integrity is particularly notable.  

A defining moment came when Stefan mediated a conflict between marketing and engineering teams over a feature timeline. By presenting data-driven trade-offs and facilitating workshops, he secured buy-in for a phased rollout, ensuring the product met both quality and launch deadlines. His collaborative approach and attention to detail are consistently evident in his work.  

Stefan is a thoughtful, self-motivated professional who thrives in dynamic environments. His contributions to our research group and his ability to bridge technical and business objectives make him a strong candidate for advanced roles in product leadership.  

Sincerely,  
Dr. Elena Varga  
Professor of Digital Innovation
